$comment: The topics, settings, and pipelines sections are generated from the synapse_core runtime source. The models section is maintained by hand. Run `python tools/generate_synapse_lib.py` after changing either.

results.doc: The latest pipeline results, serialized with MessagePack.

captureLatency.doc: The latest capture latency, in seconds.

processLatency.doc: The latest processing latency, in seconds.

apriltag.doc: AprilTag detection and field-space pose estimation.

models.name: ApriltagDetection
models.doc: Represents a single detected AprilTag, including its screen-space position.

fields.name: tag_id
fields.doc: The unique ID of the detected AprilTag.

fields.name: hamming
fields.doc: The Hamming distance of the detection. Lower values are more accurate.

fields.name: tagPose_screenSpace
fields.doc: The center of the tag in screen space, as [x, y] pixels.

models.name: ApriltagResult
models.doc: Represents the result of detecting AprilTags in a single frame.

fields.name: cameraEstimate_fieldSpace
fields.doc: The camera pose as [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw] in degrees, or null when unavailable.

fields.name: reprojection_error
fields.doc: The reprojection error of the camera pose estimate. 0.0 when unavailable.

fields.name: bbox
fields.doc: The bounding box as [x, y, width, height].

fields.name: center
fields.doc: The center of the region as [x, y].

fields.name: area
fields.doc: The area of the region in pixels squared.

models.name: ColorResult
models.doc: Represents the result of a color detection pipeline run.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: The timestamp in seconds when the frame was processed.

fields.name: main_detection
fields.doc: The primary detection, or null when no regions were detected.
